summary.name: Neat Download Manager
summary.one_liner: A free download manager for Mac and Windows that uses segmented transfers to speed up downloads and can resume interrupted ones.
use_cases: Downloading HLS video streams as a single file
Downloading video or audio from websites via browser extension
Limiting bandwidth used by background downloads
Downloading files through proxies or authenticated servers
summary.what_it_does: Neat Download Manager accelerates downloads with a dynamic segmentation algorithm that aims to use the full available bandwidth. It supports HTTP, HTTPS and FTP, plus HTTP and SOCKS proxies and HTTP and proxy authentication (Basic, Digest, NTLM). Downloads can be paused, resumed after a crash, and renewed when expired, and bandwidth and connection limits can be changed while a download is running. It can fetch all .ts segments of an HLS video and merge them into one .ts file, and a browser extension can send links to it and help grab video or audio from websites. Downloads are organized by status and file type.
notable: Can download and merge HLS .ts segments into a single file
Bandwidth and connection limits adjustable mid-download
caveats: Drag and drop is available on Mac only, per the page
